categories.main_business_segments: Visco Optical Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the design, manufacturing, and sales of disposable soft contact lenses. Its business scope includes medical device manufacturing, wholesale and retail of medical devices and optical instruments, international trade, and optometry services. The company focuses on various types of contact lenses such as daily, bi-weekly, and monthly disposables, including products for myopia, astigmatism, multifocal, blue light blocking, and cosmetic colored lenses.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in silicon hydrogel (SiHy) contact lens technology, which offers high oxygen permeability and comfort. It employs advanced manufacturing processes including injection molding, color printing, curing, hydration, inspection, sterilization, and packaging. The firm continuously improves optical designs, surface treatments, and incorporates AI-driven automated inspection and production line automation to enhance product quality and production efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Visco serves major global markets including Asia (notably China, Japan, and South Korea), Europe, and the Americas, targeting large-scale distributors, brand owners, and eye care professionals. Its customers include international contact lens brands and regional distributors, with a focus on both prescription and cosmetic lens segments. The company also supports online and offline retail channels, including e-commerce platforms.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates manufacturing facilities in Malaysia and sales subsidiaries in Japan, China, and Taiwan. Its sales are distributed globally with significant revenue contributions from Asia (59%), Europe (24%), and the Americas (4%). The company holds product registrations and certifications across major markets including the US, Europe, Japan, China, Australia, and South Korea.
categories.supply_chain_position: Visco operates primarily in the midstream segment of the contact lens supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and product development. It sources raw materials such as HEMA and silicone acrylates and supplies finished lenses to brand owners and distributors. The company also engages in some downstream activities through its sales subsidiaries and optometry services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in silicon hydrogel lens materials, optical design improvements for multifocal and astigmatism lenses, blue light blocking technology, and high-moisture formulations to enhance wearer comfort. It invests in manufacturing process innovations including AI inspection, automated color printing adjustments, and production line capacity expansion. The strategic focus includes expanding product lines tailored to regional market needs and securing global regulatory certifications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of disposable contact lenses to brand owners, distributors, and retailers worldwide. The company also earns income from related medical device sales and optometry services. It does not rely on subscription or licensing models but focuses on volume sales and product diversification.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Visco is positioned as Asia's leading silicon hydrogel contact lens manufacturer and ranks fifth globally. It competes against major global brands such as Johnson & Johnson, Alcon, CooperVision, and Bausch + Lomb, which dominate market share and professional channels. Visco differentiates itself through specialized silicon hydrogel expertise, comprehensive product certifications, and strong customer relationships in Asia and other regions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$2.78 billion in 2022, a 41% increase from the previous year, with net profit reaching NT$617 million. It has shown consistent growth in sales and profitability, driven by expanding market share in Europe and China. The company completed a successful IPO in late 2022, increasing capital and strengthening its financial position with total assets exceeding NT$5.29 billion and equity of NT$3.1 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Visco emphasizes high oxygen permeability, comfort, and safety in its silicon hydrogel lenses, offering a full product line that meets diverse consumer needs including multifocal, astigmatism, and cosmetic lenses. Its proprietary technology and global regulatory approvals provide customers with reliable, high-quality products. The company also offers flexible production capacity and responsive customer service, enabling tailored solutions and strong partnerships with global brands.
